'''2021 Worlds Throwback Top 8 Ryan Sersen LS Hidden Base''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Ryan Sersen]] at the [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]] (Top 8).

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ryan Sersen]]
* '''Event:''' [[2021 Worlds Throwback Event]]
* '''Stage:''' Top 8
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Starting Interrupt:''' [[Heading For The Medical Frigate]] · [[The Signal]]
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:21WRPR2 Sersen LS HB.txt |Download]]
